verdict.rationale: SolidJS advertises being 'web component friendly' and able to author custom elements, plus isomorphic client/server rendering, which supports embedding small interactive widgets into existing pages without a full rewrite. However, there is no explicit documentation or example of mounting Solid components into an existing server-rendered HTML page (e.g., islands architecture, a `render()`-into-a-DOM-node walkthrough), and community comments focus on SPA-style usage and docs gaps rather than incremental adoption. Missing for 10: explicit incremental-adoption/mounting guide, islands-architecture example, and hands-on confirmation of embedding into a non-Solid server-rendered page.
